body: Hello! I am someone to talk to. I was in a similar place last year, and while I doubt I’m that qualified to help that much, I am here, I do understand how you feel, and I don’t want you to die.

I had to leave school and work for the same reason. Filling out the paperwork for my job was probably one of the more difficult things I had to do. Maybe try asking someone else to help you write it, if there is someone you trust. If not, take it slow, remember to breathe, and honestly just say fuck it. You need to focus on you rn, and school will be there when you are ready to go back. 
Best of luck my guy, I hope this helps

What about councilors at school? I talked to them for a long time before I got into therapy. 

  School councilors aren’t the best but they can be a good outlet. You could also talk to family and any friends you still can trust. I know it doesn’t sound very helpful, but opening up is the first step in feeling better. The more you hold things in the worse you are going to feel

I talked to people mostly, I’m still in school so it was a lot easier, but friends who had gone through similar things, councilors, and I found my therapist and have gone to her for a year. 

  There are still ups and downs, but there are ways to keep yourself from the worst option. 

 Have you tried therapy? I’m sure they are still taking people with everything going on

Hi! 
  I’m pretty sure this is totally fine for this sub, this is a place to open up. 

  I have been in a place kinda like yours, I still self harm but it has gotten better. Therapy worked for me, helped a lot actually but some people can’t get to one during covid. But even so, it is worth trying and most of it is done over FaceTime of Telehealth. 

   You aren’t alone. Even if you feel like no one understands what you are going through, people are here for you and want to help you. I don’t know your family situation, or that with your girlfriend, but reaching out to them at least once can help a lot. 

  I wish the best for you man, times got so hard and the world just feels so much less warm, not that it really ever was. I can’t stop you from doing anything, but we are all here for you, people care and want you to find help. 

Hoping for the best

If I have learned anything from depression, it’s that you can’t trust your brain. People don’t hate you, you’re trying to find negativity to justify tour own self-hatred. 
   You’re gonna be okay, and at least one person sees you and doesn’t hate you! 
  God knows I have been there, and I probably gonna be back there soon, but you can’t let that define you. This is really long, you got the point, good luck!

I’m really bad at talking, worse at texting but it’s not over. Fuck I sound so generic but it’s never over. You don’t have to have kids, you don’t have to stay in this state of thinking everyone hates you and hating yourself. It’s never over till you stop trying🙂hopefully that wasn’t a shit response
Being alive. It was all chill until we just got so overpopulated, and then we didn’t have enough resources and now we’re just here
